findings.issue: The References section understates the source and ends with a false disclaimer: this file is a line-by-line adaptation of `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subobject/MonoOver.lean`, not just "both are full subcategories of an over category". Verbatim proof terms: line 141 `inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((forget X ⋙ Over.forget X).map f))` = MonoOver.lean:140-141; line 148 `(isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (...)).symm` = MonoOver.lean:144-145; line 123 `homMk e.inv (by rw [e.inv_comp_eq, w])` = MonoOver.lean:132; also `forget`, `CoeOut`, `mk`, `mk_coe`, `mk_proj`(=`mk_arrow`), `fullyFaithfulForget`, `w`, `homMk`, `mkProjIso`(=`mkArrowIso`). All duplicated again in the `ConnectedCoveringSpace` namespace (lines 162-259). The PR description repeats the same claim ("No Mathlib proof or declaration is vendored").

summary: MonoOver is named as the model, but the file and PR description describe it as a mere structural analogy and assert "No Mathlib proof is vendored", while several declarations and proof terms are copied verbatim from `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Subobject/MonoOver.lean` modulo renaming. Fix the wording of the credit.
